name: Budget direction
description: Whether a budget line is money in, money out, or a financing movement. Required on every line, because a bare amount cannot be interpreted without it - 41,200,000 is meaningless until you know which way it flows.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Revenue
hasDefinedTerm.description: Money received: taxes, grants, fees, fines.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Expenditure
hasDefinedTerm.description: Money spent on the delivery of government functions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Financing
hasDefinedTerm.description: Movements in assets and liabilities: borrowing, repayment, transfers to reserves.
